record_id.reason: id is distinct across all 206548 rows. Licence Number repeats across licence classes (112656 distinct), so it cannot identify a row alone.

fields.reason: Register of licensees; the licensee name is the registered licensee name. Individuals are mapped as legal_name per rule 4 and not inferred as sole_trader. Mixed case and upper case both occur.

Column name and samples are clearly ABN (11 digits). Values are space-grouped (e.g. '37 315 662 283'); the abn checksum transform must accept the grouped form or the engine will reject them and show me.
Column name and samples are clearly ACN (9 digits, space-grouped). Only populated for companies (fill rate 0.237). Checksum applied via acn transform.
Free-text business address for the licensee, as the source states it.
Samples consistently end with 'STATE POSTCODE'. Derived from the address string (L1 parse), so confidence is lower than a direct column.
Trailing 4-digit postcode in every sample. Derived from the address string, so confidence is lower than a direct column.
Explicit entity-type column. 'Company' maps to company. 'Individual' is deliberately left out: it describes a person licensee, not a sole_trader, so it is rejected and the engine records unknown.

unmapped.reason: Regulator licence identifier for the authorisation. No ontology field for it. Repeats across licence classes, so not a record key.
Code duplicate of Licence Type DESC (I/C). Not mapped separately; the DESC column carries the entity-type signal.

Per-row licence class (e.g. Carpentry, Builder - Low Rise). It describes an authorisation held by the licensee, not the entity's industry. The ontology has no licence-class field, and translating it to industry_code would be a guess.
Regulator financial-category classification with no ontology field.
Code duplicate of Financial Category DESC with no ontology field.
Licence grade (Builder, Trade Contractor, Nominee Supervisor, etc.). No ontology field for licence grade.

source_reliability_basis: Identity: a statutory regulator's licensing register (QBCC) holding ABN/ACN and licensee names is high-trust for identity. Address: the licensee-declared business address is authoritative for the register but can lag reality and is free text. Classification: licence class and grade are regulator-recorded, so high trust for what is authorised, but they are not the entity's industry. Contact: the dataset has no phone, email or website, so 0.5 (cannot tell).
